title: Aromatic Japanese Tofu Shio Ramen
description: A yeasty, molten ramen that fuels post-workout recovery with a vegan twist, enriched by vegetarian Worcestershire sauce and crispy tempeh lardons.
instructions: Heat a pot over medium heat and pour in the vegetable broth.
Add soy sauce, vegetarian Worcestershire sauce, miso paste, and nutritional yeast, stirring until well combined.
Drop the ramen noodles into the broth and cook for 3 minutes until al dente.
Fold in the cubed tofu and simmer for another 2 minutes, allowing the tofu to absorb the flavors.
In a small pan, heat toasted sesame oil and pour in the coconut milk to create a molten, creamy base.
Pour the coconut milk mixture into the ramen pot, stirring gently to blend the textures.
Gently toss in the pre-cooked tempeh lardons, distributing them evenly across the bowl.
Serve the ramen hot in a talavera plate, topping with fresh chives for a burst of color and aroma.
Let the dish rest for a minute before enjoying to let the flavors meld.
